summary: You may know exactly where your no is before you have finished explaining it.
body: You may know exactly where your no is before you have finished explaining it. Mars trine Lilith can make it easier to act on a boundary, preference, or decision you have been softening because you expected resistance. Decline the request, correct the assumption, leave the plan you never agreed to, or pursue the option you actually want. Defiance is useful when it protects a decision that matters. It becomes less useful when opposing someone is the only reason to keep going.
